title: 電気回路Ⅳ(電気工学)
subtitle: Electric Circuits IV for Electrical Engineering
educationalGoal: (1)Students will learn how to calculate the electric circuit of three-phase electricity. (2)Students will learn Fourier series of periodic wave. (3)Students will learn how to calculate the electric circuit with distorted wave.
advice: We will cover the following materials: 10.Three-phase AC circuits 10.1.1 Configurations of three-phase AC circuits 10.1.2 Connection diagrams of three-phase sources 10.1.3 Connection diagrams of three-phase loads 10.1.4 Conversion of a balanced load from star and delta connection, and vice-versa 10.1.5 Analysis of three-phase AC circuits: voltage and current calculations 10.1.6 Analysis of three-phase AC circuits: power calculations 8. Distorted wave 8.1 Introduction of distorted wave 8.2 Analysis of distorted waveforms: power calculations 8.3 Analysis of distorted waveforms: the calculation of form factor, crest factor and distortion factor 8.4 Fourier series: Fourier series expansion of distorted waveforms 8.5 Fourier series: Fourier series expansion of even and odd function
books: Fundamentals of Electric Circuits[Corona Publishing Co., Ltd.](in Japanese)
requiredKnowledge: Fully understanding of “Electric Circuit I, II, III”. Basic knowledge and application ability of mathematics such as complex number, calculus and trigonometric function.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the basic concept of the three phase electricity and analyze the circuit.
Be able to calculate the equivalent conversion between the delta and star connection.
Be able to understand the Fourier series of the distorted wave.
Be able to calculate the Fourier series of the distorted wave.
Be able to analyze the circuit with the distorted wave.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Explain the concept of three-phase AC circuits by mathematical expressions and conduct circuit calculations. (2) Calculate equivalent impedances between delta and star connection. (3) Calculate the current, voltage, and power of three-phase AC circuits. (4) Derive a Fourier series formula by yourself and explain the meaning of the formula strictly. (5) Calculate Fourier series of periodic waveform. (6) Correctly calculate the distorted wave current, voltage and power of electric circuit.
achievementLevels.standard: Achieve the 5 items of action goal.
